messages:
Maria Chen: Heads-up — entering AMBER standby for the EU change window at 23:00 UTC. No hotfix merges to prod unless pre-cleared. I'll run canary smoke at T+5m.
Jamie Ortiz: Ack. Pausing PR merges to the prod branch. Who's owning smoke?
Lee Patel: I'll own smoke and watch dashboards. Will run quick end-to-end and latency checks.
Maria Chen: Lee — thanks. Pin release artifact v2.7.3 to prod-A now. No automatic re-pinning.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary start initiated: release=v2.7.3 group=prod-A strategy=gradual batches=10% wait=5m
Rachel Nguyen: Release notes pushed to Confluence: https://confluence/redwood/releases/v2.7.3 — added rollback steps & known issues.
Lee Patel: Smoke results: basic API checks 200/200, auth flow ok. p95 +8ms vs baseline. I'll monitor for 10m and report.
OpsAlert: ops-alert: embeddings-inference 5xx rate 0.30% over last 3m — under alert threshold.
Jamie Ortiz: Setting rollback triggers: 5xx >= 0.8% sustained for 10m OR p95 latency > 250ms for more than 5m. Also manual rollback if major functional regression observed.
Maria Chen: Rollback playbook: target -> v2.7.2 (already pinned). Steps: 1) notify channel, 2) deploy-bot rollback start --to v2.7.2 --groups prod-A, 3) validate smoke, 4) escalate to infra if rollback fails. Lee, be ready to execute.
Lee Patel: Command ready. Example: `deploy-bot rollback start --to v2.7.2 --groups prod-A` — will run validation post-rollback.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary at 30% complete, health checks passing, no exceptions flagged.
Rachel Nguyen: :thumbsup: Scheduling the +1h post-deploy smoke and a short release notes announcement if full rollout completes.
Jamie Ortiz: Reminder: no infra changes or schema migrations during standby window. @Oncall-Team please hold planned infra ops.
Maria Chen: Thanks all. If no issues by +30m we proceed to full rollout. Keep updates brief here (pass/fail + short note).
